name: Apply Closet Shelf Finish (Spray + Roll-off)
intent: Spray on finish coat then immediately roll off with a dry mini-roller to create an orange-peel / stipple texture that hides bare-wood grain raise. Bare-wood only (spray_rolloff on primed or melamine adds no value). Rate between brush and pure spray.

tasks.name: Spray + Roll-Off Closet Shelf Finish Coat

doctrine: Slower than pure spray because each pass has a rolloff immediately behind. Same masking footprint as MOD_APPLY_CLOSET_SHELF_FINISH_SPRAY — wall + fixtures.
